newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian Resources buys NSTP shares.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian Resources buys NSTP shares.

text.p: Malaysian Resources Corp Bhd (MRCB) said on Wednesday it had bought an additional 1.995 million shares in publishing group New Straits Times Press (Malaysia) Bhd (NSTP) on the open market.
The shares were acquired between April 1 and 11 at prices ranging from 14.70 to 15.10 ringgit, it said in a statement.
Following the acquisition, MRCB, a diversified conglomerate, now holds 88.565 million shares or 44.66 percent interest in NSTP, the statement said.
Shares of NSTP closed on Wednesday at 14.70 ringgit, down 20 cents.
